title: Access the fish2 FlyEM Dataset
text: goal fishr provide natverse access fish2 larval zebrafish whole-brain EM dataset. follows general pattern malecns malevnc, providing dataset-specific helpers top neuprintr package bridge broader natverse connectomics tooling computational neuroanatomy. fish2 dataset currently proofread Janelia Research Campus part multi-institution collaboration including Harvard Google Research. initial package focuses : dataset selection helpers (choose_fish(), with_fish()) body id lookup (fish_ids()) neuprint metadata connectivity queries (fish_neuprint_meta(), fish_connection_table()) DVID body annotations (fish_dvid_annotations()) neuroglancer meshes skeletons (read_fish_meshes(), read_fish_neurons()) support coconat interface (register_fish_coconat())

title: Access the fish2 FlyEM Dataset
text: new R, recommend installing RStudio IDE base R detailed https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/#download. install fishr package dependencies, R terminal : also need make sure authenticated clio neuprint.
code: # install natmanager if needed if (!requireNamespace("natmanager")) install.packages("natmanager") natmanager::install(pkgs = "flyconnectome/fishr")

title: Access the fish2 FlyEM Dataset
text: Access neuprint requires authentication. recommend running: interactive R session following prompts. help record token offer set fish2 dataset/server default neuprint commands. See https://github.com/natverse/neuprintr#authentication learn relevant environment variables. need authenticate Clio API interact Clio/DVID annotation system. via Google OAuth “dance” web browser automatically triggered choose_fish() functions require Clio access. Note Clio neuprint tokens look similar, . Note also neuprint token appears indefinite Clio token currently lasts 3 weeks.
code: library(fishr) fish_setup()

title: Access the fish2 FlyEM Dataset
text: example shows basic activities including finding ids type, fetching metadata connectivity information, reading plotting retinal ganglion cell meshes. can also set annotations programmatically. default associate email (timestamp) just like Clio web interface. can useful careful (ask help quickly slack suspect accident)!
code: library(fishr) library(nat) # you only have to run this once, but you can  fish_setup()  # find some RGCs rgc10=fish_ids("RGC")[1:10] # get metadata fish_neuprint_meta(rgc10)  # connectivity query fish_connection_table(rgc10, partners = "outputs")  # fetch some RGC meshes rgcm <- read_fish_meshes(rgc10) plot3d(rgcm)  # read and plot one fish skeleton rgcn <- read_fish_neurons(rgc10[1]) plot3d(rgcn, col = "cyan")  # Get meshes for some ROIs. NB not all ROIs have meshes. roi.meshes <- fish_roi_meshes(c("Midbrain", "Hindbrain"), .progress = "none") wire3d(roi.meshes, col='grey') anns=data.frame(bodyid=c(1001,1002), side='R', type='RGC_AF8') fish_annotate(anns) fish_annotate(anns, test=F)

what: Convert xyz points between fish2 coordinate systems — fish_coords
title: Convert xyz points between fish2 coordinate systems — fish_coords
text: fish2 uses three distinct voxel scales turn   day--day work: nm (canonical unit spatial transforms like   mirror_fish), raw ((16, 16, 15) nm voxel grid stored   neuprint's somaLocation friends, accepted DVID   segmentation/labels endpoint), emraw ((8, 8, 30) nm voxel   grid EM imagery Clio / Neuroglancer URL conventions).   fish_coords converts , plus microns.

title: Convert xyz points between fish2 coordinate systems — fish_coords
code: fish_coords(xyz, from = "nm", to = "nm", as_character = FALSE)

title: Convert xyz points between fish2 coordinate systems — fish_coords
text: xyz Point coordinates. Anything accepted xyzmatrix (vector, matrix, data.frame, "x,y,z" strings). , Source target units. One "nm" (default), "raw" (16, 16, 15 nm voxels, neuprint grid), "emraw" (8, 8, 30 nm voxels, EM acquisition grid), "microns". as_character TRUE, return character vector "x,y,z" strings via xyzmatrix2str.

title: Convert xyz points between fish2 coordinate systems — fish_coords
text: Nx3 numeric matrix requested units, character vector   as_character = TRUE.

title: Convert xyz points between fish2 coordinate systems — fish_coords
text: fish2 two "raw" voxel grids. raw (16, 16, 15)   nm grid used neuprint (stores somaLocation friends   raw, DVID segmentation/labels endpoint accepts raw   coordinates). emraw (8, 8, 30) nm acquisition grid   EM imagery convention used Clio / Neuroglancer URLs. two   grids differ per axis (emraw twice XY resolution raw half   Z resolution): emraw = raw * c(2, 2, 0.5).

title: Convert xyz points between fish2 coordinate systems — fish_coords
code: # neuprint "raw" -> EM "emraw" fish_coords(c(57780, 28028, 10984), from = "raw", to = "emraw") #>           X     Y    Z #> [1,] 115560 56056 5492  # emraw -> nm fish_coords(c(115560, 56056, 5492), from = "emraw", to = "nm") #>           X      Y      Z #> [1,] 924480 448448 164760  # batch + character output fish_coords(rbind(c(115560, 56056, 5492), c(0, 0, 0)),             from = "emraw", to = "raw", as_character = TRUE) #> [1] "57780,28028,10984" "0,0,0"

what: Predict the L/R side of points in fish2 space — fish_point_side
title: Predict the L/R side of points in fish2 space — fish_point_side
text: Applies fish2 mirror transform input point   measures signed displacement along mirror (Y) axis   transform. sign indicates side midline point lies .

title: Predict the L/R side of points in fish2 space — fish_point_side
code: fish_point_side(   xyz,   units = c("nm", "raw", "emraw", "microns"),   threshold = 5000,   rval = c("side", "distance") )

title: Predict the L/R side of points in fish2 space — fish_point_side
text: xyz Point coordinates. Anything accepted xyzmatrix (matrix, data.frame, neuron, neuronlist), length-3 numeric vector single point, character vector comma-separated "x,y,z" strings (fishr convention location columns). units Units input coordinates. "nm" (default) matches mirror_fish; "raw", "emraw" "microns" scaled nm via fish_coords first. threshold Distance midline points reported M rather L R. Default 5000 nm (~5 \(\mu\)m, ~1% y (medio-lateral) extent fish2 brain). Set 0 values L R rval return. "side" (default) gives character vector side labels ("L", "R" "M"). "distance" gives signed distance midline nm (always nm, regardless units), positive right, negative left.

title: Predict the L/R side of points in fish2 space — fish_point_side
text: rval = "side", character vector "L",   "R" "M", one per input point, NA bad points.   rval = "distance", numeric vector signed distances   midline nm.

title: Predict the L/R side of points in fish2 space — fish_point_side
text: right-side points dist = (mirror_y - y)/2 < 0. Points   |dist| <= threshold reported midline. dist==0   threshold==0 points reported "R".

text: fish_somapos returns soma position requested   body, preferring somaLocation field falling back   tosomaLocation former missing. fish_soma_side returns logical side   requested body dataset. side may derived manual   annotation (one exists), instance name suffix, soma's   position relative fish2 midline.

code: fish_somapos(   ids,   units = c("nm", "raw", "emraw", "microns"),   as_character = FALSE )  fish_soma_side(   ids,   method = c("auto", "manual", "instance", "position"),   threshold = 0 )

title: Soma positions and logical sides for fish2 neurons — fish_somapos
text: ids Body ids, query string (see fish_ids), metadata data.frame returned fish_neuprint_meta. units Units returned coordinates. neuprint somaLocation / tosomaLocation values stored raw voxel coordinates; fish_coords converts requested units. "nm" (default) scales fish2 raw voxel size (16, 16, 15); "raw" passes ; "emraw" returns (8, 8, 30) nm acquisition grid; "microns" returns nm / 1000. as_character TRUE, return character vector "x,y,z" strings (fishr convention location columns). Default FALSE. method One "auto" (default), "manual", "instance", "position". See Details. threshold Absolute Y displacement (nm) position reports soma midline ("M"). Default 0. Ignored instance manual.

title: Soma positions and logical sides for fish2 neurons — fish_somapos
text: fish_somapos returns Nx3 numeric matrix   columns x, y, z, character vector   "x,y,z" strings as_character = TRUE. Bodies   neither somaLocation tosomaLocation produce   NA rows. fish_soma_side returns character vector "L",   "R", "M", "U" NA, one entry per input   body.

title: Soma positions and logical sides for fish2 neurons — fish_somapos
text: "side" returned fish_soma_side **logical**   side neuron dataset, necessarily side   physical soma. ascending fibre entering brain nerve   outside EM volume, side reflects entry point.   neuron may soma one side cord cross   side entering imaged volume; assigned side follow   entry nerve, soma. Methods fish_soma_side: auto Try manual first, fill remaining       NAs instance, position. manual Read neuprint somaSide column       directly. Returns NA bodies manual       assignment. instance Match _([LRMU])$       name (instance) column. position Classify soma signed displacement       fish2 midline via fish_point_side.       threshold forwarded -; default 0 means       position never returns "M". "M" reserved       bilaterally symmetric unpaired neurons flagged       instance suffix.

text: with_fish temporarily changes server/dataset options   malevnc package target fish2 dataset   running expression. choose_fish_dataset sets default dataset used   fish_* functions. recommended way access fish2 dataset   variants. Unlike choose_fish permanently change   default dataset used callers use functions malevnc   package directly. choose_fish swaps default malevnc   dataset fish2 dataset. means functions   malevnc package target fish2 instead. recommended   use with_fish temporarily unless   intention using FlyEM datasets. switch default fishr   dataset please see choose_fish_dataset. Clio dataset lookup unavailable, choose_fish falls back   built-neuprint-configuration main fish2 dataset.   Clio-backed functionality may unavailable   session.

title: fishr 0.3.0
text: Several new features including L/R-side classifier, soma-position helpers unified xyz coordinate converter, plus DVID body lookup points.

title: fishr 0.3.0
text: Add fish_point_side() predict L/R/M side points fish2 space applying mirror_fish() measuring signed y displacement across midline; supports units = "nm" / "raw" / "emraw" / "microns", configurable midline threshold rval = "side" / "distance". @jefferis https://github.com/flyconnectome/fishr/pull/4 Add fish_somapos() fish_soma_side() soma queries fish2 metadata. fish_somapos() returns Nx3 matrix soma positions (preferring somaLocation, falling back row-wise tosomaLocation) requested units; fish_soma_side() classifies logical side body via auto / instance (_L/_R/_M/_U suffix) / position (fish_point_side() soma), manual reserved future somaSide column. @jefferis https://github.com/flyconnectome/fishr/pull/4 Add fish_coords() single public converter fish2’s voxel scales: nm, raw ((16, 16, 15) nm grid stored neuprint’s somaLocation accepted DVID segmentation/labels endpoint), emraw ((8, 8, 30) nm acquisition grid used Clio / Neuroglancer URLs) microns. as_character = TRUE returns "x,y,z" strings via nat::xyzmatrix2str(). @jefferis https://github.com/flyconnectome/fishr/pull/7 Add fish_xyz2bodyid() look segmentation body id 3D point via malevnc::manc_xyz2bodyid(), returning character ids. Default units = "emraw" matches typical interactive case pasting coordinates fish2 neuroglancer URL; raw, nm microns also accepted. @jefferis https://github.com/flyconnectome/fishr/pull/7 Fix fish_neuprint_meta(NULL) return soma-related columns (somaLocation, nsoma, somaSide, …) fish_neuprint_meta(ids) passing full possibleFields list neuprintr::neuprint_get_meta() -bodies code path. @jefferis https://github.com/flyconnectome/fishr/pull/4 Refactor fish_point_side() fish_somapos() delegate unit conversion fish_coords() (gain "emraw" units value). fish_somapos() now returns matrices natverse-standard uppercase X/Y/Z column names. @jefferis https://github.com/flyconnectome/fishr/pull/7
